notes.title: 🌟 What Kind of Student Will You Be? 3 DAYS LEFT UNTIL RELEASE
notes.notes: [p][b][i]For the first time ever[/i][/b], inventory management meets dating-sim in a bold fusion that delivers a truly unique experience. Your items aren’t just for show. They shape how you engage in every conversation and win hearts, [b][i]offering you a sensational experience like no other. [/i][/b]Each person you encounter brings unique skills and persuasive strategies. Be prepared to adapt and respond to every challenge.[/p][p]Master one of the traits, Confidence, Charm, Kindness, or Knowledge, [b][i]for great replayability.[/i][/b] Each unlocks over 300 powerful items with rich stats. Experiment, combine, and create thrilling builds for endless strategic fun. This addictive core gameplay [b][i]promises countless hours of entertainment.[/i][/b][/p][h3][b]💋 Charm[/b][/h3][p]Charm makes you magnetic, smooth-talking, confident in flirty moments, and always one step ahead in emotional tension. You’ll breeze through social situations and find the right words at just the right time. A must-have for those who want to dazzle and dominate emotionally charged encounters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/dfc5fb01df710ccae688a91e0cb77b1603dde83c.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]📚 Knowledge[/b][/h3][p]Knowledge gives you the upper hand in academic events, thoughtful dialogue, and even strategic romance. You’re sharp, prepared, and always calculating your next move. With this trait, every conversation becomes a puzzle to solve and you’ll have the tools to do it flawlessly.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/208e9e5b9e0a840ee74124a0d723cb84719202a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]💪 Confidence[/b][/h3][p]Confidence opens doors, literally and figuratively. You don’t hesitate; you act. This trait gives you bold choices, fearless comebacks, and the presence to stand your ground in intense situations. It’s the edge you need when emotions run high and pressure rises.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/c01f2df694508595a6f8a0e83397112367565f5f.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]🌸 Kindness[/b][/h3][p]Kindness is your strength when things get real. This trait turns empathy into power, helping you defuse conflict, deepen connections, and uncover vulnerability in even the toughest hearts. When sincerity matters more than swagger, Kindness wins.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/f9d630d081a47acba0a8897faf19789f7a79cd62.jpg"][/img][/p][p]🎒 [b]Pro tip[/b]: Collect and equip [b]Socialize items[/b] that boost your trait-based stats. You’ll need clever combinations to “battle” these girls effectively, each with her own emotional armor. [/p][p][/p][p]💕 Let's build your strategy,wins the hearts, and unlock the full experience with all the gorgeous ladies. Your sensational student life will begin very soon![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/21a8e4ac50a6783764a8f5e8f00dd4056fe39bf1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🎯 [b]Wishlist [i]Love n Life: Happy Student[/i][/b] now if you haven’t already![/p][p]🗓️ Mark your calendar for [b]4 am, July 18 (Pacific time)[/b], you won’t want to miss your next study session with these irresistible ladies and the [b]Big Discount of 30%[/b] at release![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3149980/Love_n_Life_Happy_Student/"][/dynamiclink]Join the vibrant Reborn community on [url="https://discord.com/invite/zHrRdQDYfn"]Discord[/url], connect with other players, share your ideas, and become part of our growing community. notes.title: BIG UPDATE 3.0.0 And MORE!
notes.notes:
After over two months of hard work, and actively analyzing feedback from the Reborn Entertainment community, we are excited to announce that Love n Life: Lucky Teacher v3.0.0 is officially live! 

Don't miss out on this exciting update with many new features and fantastic improvements bringing you the ultimate experience you deserve!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176691/89d3dc821882e036723332fc50cc5be824013926.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Patch note 3.0.0:[/b][/h2]

[b]New Characters:[/b]
[list]
[*] The long-requested Rina!: Unlocked in the classroom or church.
[*] The caring Nurse: Unlocked during exhaustion emergency or at Festival 2.
[*] Your personal Secretary: Unlocked after acquiring a personal office at school.
[/list]
[b]New Locations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cinema at the Entertainment Center
[*] Farm
[*] Supermarket
[*] Church
[*] Director’s Office
[/list]
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] New fun interactions: Available after two dates with new characters.
[*] Cooking Mini-Game: Buy a kitchen from the Amazoo app, harvest crops at the farm, and purchase ingredients at the restaurant.
[*] New Shops: Buy/sell items at the Restaurant & Supermarket.
[*] Farm Harvesting: Collect crops, chickens, and eggs
[/list].
[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mission trigger conditions at the 1st Festival are adjusted from 3 to 2 hearts.
[*] Slightly increased the salary of the main job at the beginning of the game and the part-time job
[*] The Harem ending now occurs after owning the personal office.
[*] Added 2 new languages: Portuguese and Spanish
[/list]
[b]Experience it now! Update and join us in discovering new and exciting features.
[/b]
[h3][b]What’s Next? 
[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] We understand your desires, and we are here to ensure you’re well pleased:

notes.title: Release Day
notes.notes:
Hello dear community,

The good news is that finally, after receiving feedback from Steam, Love n Life Lucky Teacher is ready to be released to the community. However, contrary to our initial plans, we need to release the game before the Winter Sale begins. Therefore, we have to postpone the official release date to avoid competing with major games.

For those who may not be aware, a regrettable incident with a previous game from Reborn Entertainment, Love n War: Hero by Chance II, was officially released on the same day as the launch of Baldur's Gate 3. This resulted in revenue challenges for a game that had invested a significant amount of effort and money but had not yet recouped its costs.

Sincerely, we understand that all of you are eagerly anticipating the gaming experience, and we also wish to release the games as soon as possible. However, to avoid risks for the project, we must be patient for a bit longer. The expected release date for Love n Life Lucky Teacher is [b]January 19, 2024.[/b]

The game will be thoroughly fixed for all bugs, improve UI/UX, and introduce an entirely new feature that is sure to make Love n Life Lucky Teacher stand out among similar products. Stay tuned to not miss out on interesting updates.

[b]Wishing you all a peaceful Christmas season![/b]

Best wishes,
Reborn Team.

notes.title: [Dev Update #1] Master the Balance between Love and Life
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176691/bcb74429739d0901820ec83738c43e99419710a6.jpg[/img]

Losing your job was a devastating shock following the Covitch69 pandemic. Now, you find yourself in a small town, where life appears to have come to a standstill, leaving you with a sense of helplessness and despair.

However, You soon find new joys in the new environment,  jobs, exercising, studying, and relationships, making each day more meaningful. And so, on this journey, you encounter intriguing personalities.

[h3][i]Immerse yourself in love with the exciting gameplay.
[/i][/h3]💕 Will you be an honest, sensitive, or a smooth-talking bad boy? Your choices in conversations with the girls will shape various outcomes. You’ll experience the fulfillment of exploration and the yearning for love from these girls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176691/cbbee3e59f1d518bcc9a22497b01073d3a92ccb3.gif[/img]

💕 Diligently working, studying, and exercising not only bring financial gains but also enrich the mind and enhance physical well-being.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176691/b689a0c734d552674db4ef0f50cc5cf67f834cda.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176691/b9718f65e175cd203edef3ed46963dc666f033ad.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176691/20aa46127168b391de3a42ee00f4684d6eb8b135.gif[/img]

💕 Explore the beautiful city and fun locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176691/54d96d9d91c111a393a01a11826c029527608ff7.jpg[/img]

💕Sometimes you can give gifts to the girls on special occasions (e.g., a beautiful dress or room decor).
